title: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
authors: Koki Takeshita, Kenji Uebayashi, Hikaru Tomonari, Masaya Tsunokake, Koichiro Yawata, Tatsuya Sasaki, Yusuke Ohtsubo, Kota Dohi, Yasuhiro Sogawa

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26904，Comments 为 'Accepted at COLM 2026'）：Pareto-Optimal RTL 的目标是改变 RLVR 的优化对象——'not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space'。批评很具体：现有方法 'aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward'，于是 'difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs'。方法两部分：把 'coverage improvement of the entire Pareto solution set' 改写成顺序生成问题（generation-based training pipeline），以及基于 'Hypervolume Contribution (HVC)' 的奖励函数衡量每个生成电路对 Pareto 面的贡献。数字为作者自述：RTLLM v2 上相对 Hypervolume 'achieves +13.3 percentage points in relative Hypervolume over a baseline without PPA optimization and +14.4 percentage points over a single-objective reinforcement learning method'，并自述在多样性上占优。价值路由：领域（RTL 生成）与我们无关，但 '把标量 reward 改成集合覆盖目标' 是一条通用 RL 训练工程启发——凡是我们在多个维度打分后再加权成一个分数的评测/训练任务（代码生成的正确性-性能-可读性、安全性-成本），加权都会塌掉一个 Pareto 面，此时应先出候选集再做 a posteriori 选择。证据边界：作者自述 'first to propose'，未核验；RTLLM v2 与两个基线的评测口径摘要未说明。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：待核验/暂无。
